                        ~&254494525842443467&~ { ~&233721384511543&~.~&6503816592&~: ~&7083038346995&~; ~&254542236275632405&~: rmNotionOverlay.rmnDefer("refresh") }

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Anchors for reMarkable OS 3.27.x (Paper Pure hashtab).
; Entry point: the share menu in the notebook toolbar — the foldout with
; "Present with Screen Share" / "Send by email" / "Convert and share".
; Send to Notion lands right after "Send by email".
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; The toolbar carries the signal so the share row can reach the document
; view the same way the stock rows do (root.toolbar.<signal>()).
AFFECT [[11313888899523275277]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            signal sendToNotionSelected
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; shareMenuContent is the ColumnLayout that holds the share buttons; the
; wildcard ?# finds it recursively. The row fires the toolbar signal by
; piggybacking on the sibling Send-by-email button's own toolbar reference
; (that button already uses root.toolbar internally), so no fragile toolbar
; The share buttons live in a ColumnLayout assigned to the ToolbarTool's
; foldoutContent property (objectName "shareMenuContent", no id). Reach it
; via root's children, then insert after Send-by-email. root.toolbar is in
; scope here (the sibling buttons use it), so the row fires the signal
; directly.
AFFECT [[14803869871714551074]]
    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]] > [[14125623155555875541]]
        LOCATE AFTER [[9623948555269757906]]
        INSERT {
                ~&6502786168&~ {
                    ~&5972374&~: rmNotionShareRow
                    ~&7081629735527&~.~&254529418434902000&~: ~&6504329801&~
                    /* Lines up with the stock rows either side of it: a*/
                    /* FoldoutItem is 112 tall and starts its content 32 in,*/
                    /* with a little padding of its own inside that.*/
                    ~&2122835675838176157&~: 112

                    ~&254501108490678590&~ {
                        ~&233721384511543&~.~&6503816592&~: ~&7083038346995&~
                        ~&214622605608&~: rmnRowTap.~&233740915843711&~ ? "#e6e6e6" : ~&"503220030291830651&~
                    }
                    /* Notion's N mark, drawn from plain Rectangles: an*/
                    /* outlined page with the two stems and the diagonal.*/
                    /* Nothing to ship as an asset, and no dependency on the*/
                    /* SVG image plugin or QtQuick.Shapes being available.*/
                    ~&6502786168&~ {
                        ~&5972374&~: rmNotionMark
                        ~&214646099849&~: 40
                        ~&7082729686082&~: 40
                        ~&233721384511543&~.~&6504027668&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&6504027668&~
                        ~&233721384511543&~.~&8399743405844438450&~: 35
                        ~&233721384511543&~.~&3441383163516681764&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&3441383163516681764&~

                        ~&254501108490678590&~ {
                            ~&233721384511543&~.~&6503816592&~: ~&7083038346995&~
                            ~&214622605608&~: ~&"214646069354&~
                            ~&7082507052999&~.~&214622605608&~: ~&"214621299494&~
                            ~&7082507052999&~.~&214646099849&~: 2
                            ~&7083116119249&~: 4
                        }
                        /* Left stem, full height of the glyph.*/
                        ~&254501108490678590&~ {
                            ~&180993&~: 10; ~&180994&~: 9
                            ~&214646099849&~: 5; ~&7082729686082&~: 22
                            ~&214622605608&~: ~&"214621299494&~
                        }
                        /* Right stem, lighter than the left one as in the mark.*/
                        ~&254501108490678590&~ {
                            ~&180993&~: 26; ~&180994&~: 9
                            ~&214646099849&~: 4; ~&7082729686082&~: 22
                            ~&214622605608&~: ~&"214621299494&~
                        }
                        /* Diagonal from the top of the left stem to the foot*/
                        /* of the right one: a vertical bar tilted to match*/
                        /* atan(16/22) ≈ 36 degrees, anticlockwise so it*/
                        /* leans the way the letter's stroke does.*/
                        ~&254501108490678590&~ {
                            ~&214646099849&~: 5
                            ~&7082729686082&~: 29
                            ~&180993&~: 20 - ~&214646099849&~ / 2
                            ~&180994&~: 20 - ~&7082729686082&~ / 2
                            ~&214622605608&~: ~&"214621299494&~
                            ~&7713532151049593&~: -36
                        }
                    }
                    ~&6503165774&~ {
                        ~&233721384511543&~.~&6504027668&~: rmNotionMark.~&214640173127&~
                        ~&233721384511543&~.~&8399743405844438450&~: 20
                        ~&233721384511543&~.~&3441383163516681764&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&3441383163516681764&~
                        ~&6504315758&~: "Send to Notion"
                        ~&6503823200&~.~&254543497768871654&~: 28
                    }
                    ~&254494525842443467&~ {
                        ~&5972374&~: rmnRowTap
                        ~&233721384511543&~.~&6503816592&~: ~&7083038346995&~
                        ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                            ~&233724020023100&~.~&6504419009&~("[rmn] row tapped; toolbar=" + ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~);
                            ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.sendToNotionSelected();
                            ~&233724020023100&~.~&6504419009&~("[rmn] signal emitted");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT SLOT rmNotionOverlay
        INSERT {
            function rmNotionOpenOverlay() {
                ~&233724020023100&~.~&6504419009&~("[rmn] rmNotionOpenOverlay; overlay=" + rmNotionOverlay);
                ~&197102514&~ ~&6504095402&~ = ~&"7711997891205770&~;
                try {
                    ~&197102514&~ ~&214624950331&~ = ~&233694067165438&~.~&8399431778896295215&~(~&7712934851008712&~.~&5972374&~);
                    ~&5972376&~ (~&214624950331&~ && ~&214624950331&~.~&505890565057603928&~) ~&6504095402&~ = ~&214624950331&~.~&505890565057603928&~;
                } catch (~&180974&~) {}
                rmNotionOverlay.rmnOpen(~&7712934851008712&~.~&5972374&~, ~&6504095402&~, "");
            }
        }

        TRAVERSE [[6502786168]]#[[15549782143769420265]] > [[233704648923420]]
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                onSendToNotionSelected: {
                    ~&233724020023100&~.~&6504419009&~("[rmn] handler reached on Toolbar");
                    ~&6504254477&~.rmNotionOpenOverlay();
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
